note: Full-project quality objectives. partial_evidence marks bounded verification only; it does not close the complete requirement or release gate.

requirements.requirement: Interrupting save at any protocol boundary leaves either the previous or the new revision intact.
requirements.verification: Fault injection and reopening; no published references to missing blobs.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/storage_tests.cpp; fault injection and abrupt-save recovery on the current SQLite protocol

requirements.requirement: Proposed autosave defaults to a configurable 60-second interval.
requirements.verification: Force shutdown during editing and recover the last committed snapshot; measure actual work loss.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/export_tests.cpp; immutable background recovery snapshot; configurable interval and measured work-loss gate remain open

requirements.requirement: Every drawing gesture is a reversible transaction, as are range edits and palette changes.
requirements.verification: Random execute/undo/redo sequences restore semantic equality.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/document_tests.cpp; transactional undo/redo invariants on current editing operations

requirements.requirement: Target p95 at or below 8 ms from sample receipt until CPU stroke processing is ready.
requirements.verification: Trace 10,000 samples on reference hardware; exclude display refresh and report it separately.

requirements.requirement: Indicative target p95 at or below 50 ms from pen to pixel in a simple scene.
requirements.verification: High-speed camera measurement on real devices; internal timings are not a substitute.

requirements.requirement: Target p95 UI frame time at or below 16.7 ms when navigating B1.
requirements.verification: Measure release builds at 1920×1080, DPR 1 and 2, with documented GPU and driver.

requirements.requirement: Maintain 24 fps in B1 after cache preparation, with accumulated audio drift no greater than one frame over ten minutes.
requirements.verification: Measure frame times and sample/playhead offset; report dropped frames.

requirements.requirement: A 10,000-frame scene creates neither one UI object per cell nor a full bitmap per frame.
requirements.verification: Inspect allocations and benchmark navigation with virtualization.
requirements.implementation_evidence: docs/implementation/STATUS.md; virtualized timeline cells; allocation benchmark for the full target remains open

requirements.requirement: Initial configurable cache budget of 2 GiB; target RSS below 4 GiB for B1 on a 16 GiB machine.
requirements.verification: Benchmark repeated open, close and edit operations; record CPU RAM and VRAM separately.

requirements.requirement: Long operations accept cancellation and return visible control within 500 ms when the backend permits.
requirements.verification: Cancel imports, renders and packaging; uncooperative processes require controlled termination.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/render_tests.cpp; cancellation inside linear frame evaluation; import/package coverage remains open

requirements.requirement: Reference CPU and GPU paths agree within operator- and precision-specific tolerances.
requirements.verification: Use alpha, gradient, blend, ICC/OCIO and HDR fixtures; no global tolerance that hides failures.

requirements.requirement: Identical revision, assets, seeds and profile produce equal semantics; deterministic CPU kernels produce exact equality.
requirements.verification: Use CPU hashes and explicit GPU tolerances; record backend versions.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/harmony_reference_tests.cpp; repeated CPU render equality on bounded artwork; wider backend determinism remains open

requirements.requirement: Build and smoke-test Windows, macOS and Linux before advertising platform support.
requirements.verification: Reproducible matrix of tested operating systems, GPUs, drivers and input devices.
requirements.implementation_evidence: docs/implementation/status.json; historical source CI matrix; current release and device matrix remain open

requirements.requirement: Normal text has at least 4.5:1 contrast, and critical controls support keyboard operation.
requirements.verification: Audit tokens, focus, accessible names and alternatives to gesture-only actions.

requirements.requirement: Do not rely on color alone for selections, errors, keyframes or states.
requirements.verification: Review the entire UI in grayscale with visible symbols and text.

requirements.requirement: Creating, editing, saving and exporting images requires neither an account nor a connection.
requirements.verification: Run WF-01 with networking disabled.

requirements.requirement: Retain opening and migration fixtures for every published format version.
requirements.verification: Migrate a copy and compare semantics/rendering; preserve the original.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/storage_tests.cpp; versioned migration and source backup fixtures through format 6; full published-format gate remains open

requirements.requirement: Reject path traversal, excessive sizes, cycles and corrupt content.
requirements.verification: Fuzz parsers and use corrupt fixtures without script execution or writes outside the destination.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/storage_tests.cpp; corrupt resources, schema limits and cycle rejection; parser fuzzing remains open

requirements.requirement: Maintain a dependency and asset inventory for every distributed binary.
requirements.verification: Record SBOM, versions, hashes and notices for the actual build; exclude non-redistributable dependencies.
requirements.implementation_evidence: docs/implementation/MACOS-PREVIEW.md; historical experimental.10 local package inventory; current binary SBOM gate remains open

requirements.requirement: Every implemented capability has an observable test or user scenario and published limits.
requirements.verification: Do not mark a capability implemented merely because nonfunctional controls exist.

requirements.requirement: Document types, units, versions, required algorithms and migrations needed to read the format.
requirements.verification: An independent tool can enumerate resources and timing without launching the UI.

requirements.requirement: Import/render errors include the operation, resource and recoverable information.
requirements.verification: A missing resource produces an exportable report without secrets or content by default.

requirements.requirement: The domain builds and is tested without Qt, codecs, networking or windows.
requirements.verification: A dedicated CMake target in CI enforces dependency boundaries between targets.
requirements.implementation_evidence: CMakeLists.txt; Qt-free document/application targets and core tests; full target-boundary CI audit remains open

requirements.requirement: IDs, sources, dependencies and generated views remain consistent.
requirements.verification: Run scripts/validate_docs.py for every catalog change.
requirements.implementation_evidence: scripts/validate_docs.py; generated catalog/roadmap and cross-record status checks; full editorial audit remains open

requirements.requirement: Every adapter explains converted, omitted and baked fields.
requirements.verification: Round-trip supported fixtures and report incompatible features.
requirements.implementation_evidence: docs/implementation/USER-GUIDE.md; explicit PNG color interpretation and batch loss rules; general interchange reports remain open

requirements.requirement: Applying an operation computed from a stale revision does not overwrite newer changes.
requirements.verification: Simulate editing during import/save; explicitly reject or rebase the result.
requirements.implementation_evidence: tests/render_tests.cpp; revision-keyed render publication rejection; all async command adapters remain open

requirements.requirement: All first-party UI, menus, tooltips, errors, accessibility labels, bundled presets, templates, help, public documentation and code identifiers use English. User-authored content supports Unicode without forced translation.
requirements.verification: Review the string inventory, built-in assets and documentation; test English UI on non-English OS locales and round-trip Unicode filenames, layers and text.
requirements.implementation_evidence: docs/design/02-language-policy.md; translated first-party docs and English UI; exhaustive string and asset audit remains open
